newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares struggle amid featureless trade.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares struggle amid featureless trade.

text.p: Latvian share volumes slid in lacklustre trade on Thursday, dulled like other Baltic markets by the prospect of a long, four-day midsummer weekend.
Trade slid to 40,000 lats from 66,000. The Rietumu index lost just 0.01 percent to 152.38. The bourse's own index was not yet available.
In a featureless market, Olainfarm stood out with trade of 19,000 lats to add one santime to 2.51 lats while Staburadze was stable at 2.69 lats on turnover of 9,200 lats.
"People seem to be more into preparing for the midsummer (holiday) festivities and a growth in activity, if any, can only be expected early in July," said one trader.
Bourse newcomer Riga Jewellery slipped further to 54 santimes from 58 on trade of 2,900 lats while Riga Transport Fleet added one santime to 1.20 on turnover of 2,100 lats.
